name: Cosplay Idol Hajimemashita♪
original_name: こすぷれアイドルはじめました♪
source:
Main character is a freshman at entertainment industry. His boss is worried about the lack of competent idols, so he asks main character to find an idol familiar with cosplay to satisfy any fan needs.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-november-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是娱乐行业的新人。老板担心缺乏有能力的偶像，于是要求主角寻找熟悉角色扮演、能够满足粉丝需求的偶像。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-november-1999.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
